title: Ivo and the Static
author: Ivo Ishikawa
blurb: Elodie Yarrow, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
